status_when_written: no fresh holdout inference and no head training performed
reason: Preserved native002 showed margin-dominated KEEP behavior; test separately trained price-aware heads on a new fixed holdout

data.head_train: first 256 episodes of original frozen TRAIN split
data.head_validation: first 128 episodes of original frozen VAL split
data.fresh_test: MNIST original test source, generate deterministic 640 episodes and take indices 512:640
data.fresh_test_overlap_prohibited: all original TRAIN, VAL and 512 TEST image source IDs
data.frontend_normalization: exact original train-only MNIST transform; no refitting
data.head_normalization: six feature means and stds from head TRAIN prefixes and all three public prices only; std floor 0.0001
data.query_target: final digit label; prefix correctness used only as offline training reward, never as head input

value_maxout.name: positive scaled softplus max-pool head with value features
value_maxout.formula: max_j softplus(a_j)*softplus(W_j*z+b_j)+b_out, four branches, six standardized inputs
value_maxout.qualification: not literal max-of-affine maxout, not an optimal free boundary; active-parameter count matching does not imply equal functional capacity; hard stop sets remain intersections of affine halfspaces

ordinary_mlp.name: ordinary tanh MLP using the same six features

optimization.optimizer: Adam default betas; no weight decay
optimization.temperature_selection: none; fixed before training and fresh test
optimization.objective: negative mean soft first-stop expected(correct_at_stop-read_price*reads); final step forced to stop
optimization.selection: maximum validation hard-Q24 utility, macro average across the three prices; ties prefer earlier update, then smaller LR
optimization.paired_batches: identical random minibatch index stream for every head and LR
optimization.budget_scope: equal update/search counts, not equal CPU; complete measured CPU charged
optimization.head_train_examples: 256 episode traces crossed with all three read prices

execution.native_transport: tanh(learned continue_score) into +/-score coordinates of unchanged width5/top_k1 native profile; KEEP iff Q24 score>0, STOP ties
execution.parity: record every float decision and quantized score; native must match Q24 action; float/Q24 disagreements allowed only for explicitly recorded rounding-to-zero ties
execution.actual_computation: one actual backbone.step and head evaluation before each actual native owner tick; STOP exits the model loop
execution.hard_horizon: finish at 32 even if native requests KEEP; record finite_horizon honestly
execution.recovery: first fresh episode at price0.005 for each learned head; restore if first observation requests KEEP, otherwise record not exercised; new native process and neural/head objects, same Python interpreter
execution.pre_holdout_gate: freeze protocol, new source files, fresh data hashes, original source identity and all head selections before fresh inference

cost_accounting.backbone_training: complete original training EXECUTION.json child CPU, including its full two-LR search
cost_accounting.head_training: charge both LR candidates and all validation/checkpoint work for each head, even when an earlier checkpoint is selected
cost_accounting.trace_generation: complete frozen-backbone TRAIN and VAL prefix computation and shared training setup charged once to each independent learned-head deployment scenario
cost_accounting.references: same backbone training charge; no learned-head search or trace charge assigned to references that do not need them
cost_accounting.execution: full evaluator wait4 CPU includes waited native descendants; native-child CPU is nested detail and must not be added again to that total
cost_accounting.shared_setup: fresh data generation and evaluator/orchestrator setup, imports and report work charged once/N to each separate policy scenario; policy scenarios are alternatives and must not be summed
cost_accounting.recovery: complete separate recovery-verification execution charged once/N, not a pure restart estimate

interpretation.primary: descriptive fresh-cohort comparison of stopping heads on one fixed trained backbone
prohibited: a head win does not prove the HCSN neuron is better than an ordinary backbone
one backbone seed and 128 deterministic fresh episodes do not establish population significance
native003 does not overwrite, tune, or reinterpret native002 as a successful maxout controller
no fresh-test-driven architecture, LR, temperature, threshold or checkpoint changes
interpretation.failures: preserve development and main failures; a bug requires a new run identity and explicit explanation
